about: Tier L4 (concurrency) bugs for the dual-hart system, docs/DUAL_HART.md. Each is one text substitution in arbiter_rr.v or amo_pcpi.v; the cores are untouched. 'liveness' bugs break no ordering rule and can only show up as a hang (bounded-time check).

bugs.name: starve_pointer
bugs.description: Round-robin pointer never advances: fixed priority hart 0 > hart 1 > AMO 0 > AMO 1.

bugs.name: amo_not_atomic
bugs.description: AMO unit does not lock the bus between its read and its write.

bugs.name: lost_write_contention
bugs.description: A write granted while both harts are requesting goes out with no byte strobes (lost).

bugs.name: log_id_amo
bugs.description: The grant log attributes an AMO read to the other hart's AMO unit (oracle-visible only).

bugs.name: ready_misroute
bugs.description: When both AMO units are requesting, the completion handshake goes to the wrong one.

bugs.name: stale_rdata
bugs.description: A requester granted twice in a row (no contention in between) receives the previous read data.

bugs.name: lock_stuck
bugs.description: The bus lock is never released after the first AMO: every other requester is locked out.

bugs.name: amo_race_window
bugs.description: The AMO lock is dropped only when the other hart's AMO unit is waiting at that moment (a true AMO race).

bugs.name: lost_write_same_word
bugs.description: A hart's write is lost when the other hart is requesting the same word address at the same time.

bugs.name: stale_rdata_amo
bugs.description: An AMO read returns the previous transaction's data when the other AMO unit is waiting.
